name: What is the process City Dweller, LLC follows for siding stripping and disposal?

mainEntity.name: What is the process City Dweller, LLC follows for siding stripping and disposal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our siding stripping process begins with a thorough site assessment and preparation, including protecting landscaping and windows. We carefully remove the old siding, ensuring minimal disruption to your property. Materials are then categorized for proper disposal, with an emphasis on recycling eligible components where possible. Throughout the process, safety protocols are strictly followed to protect both our crew and your property. Upon completion, the area is meticulously cleaned, leaving a clear, prepared surface for your new siding installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves site assessment, careful removal of old siding with property protection, proper disposal and recycling, strict safety protocols, and a thorough clean-up.
